pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes another ADR0127 first-release proving-project slice on the current Draft branch. The Launcher Native 2D template now exercises the existing input, Project Rust, CharacterController2D, Sprite Animation, declarative HUD, audio, save-slot, Tile Map and one-way platform paths in one standard project.

The standard project-lifecycle crate gains only a non-destructive Project Rust host/index refresh operation so generated template sources are compiled through the normal unified project host. The same project continues to use the normal Build/package path; no Native 2D-specific packager is introduced.
